preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 3 and 2000.
All point coordinates must be within the range [-10^9, 10^9].
There must be exactly n unique points.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n - 2 and all(c in 'LR' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n-2 and consist only of 'L' and 'R' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(p) <= n for p in stdout.split()) and len(set(stdout.split())) == n)
postconditions.description: The output must either be '-1' indicating no valid permutation, or a permutation of n unique integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: any(turns[i] == s[i] for i in range(n-2))
postconditions.description: The polygonal line must satisfy the winding condition specified by the string s.

postconditions.expression: not any(intersects(i, j) for i in range(n-1) for j in range(i+2, n))
postconditions.description: The polygonal line must be non-self-intersecting.
